decisions.reason: After four years and no later prominence on the website, this niche Magento template likely falls below aspiration and its resources are better shifted to core hosting and newer development.
The responsive website template is close to core but relatively commoditized and no longer visible, so management would read this as weak performance versus aspiration and redeploy effort elsewhere.
Premium customer support directly expresses the firm's main service promise, so it is likely still meeting aspiration and should be retained.
The software version management tool builds on the firm's technical capabilities and complements managed hosting, so without clear evidence of a shortfall below aspiration it remains worth keeping.
Scalable hosting for agencies is a flagship, highly core offering in a growing market, making it the least likely product to fall below aspiration and be withdrawn.
